output.summary: Review 2 of d1d94e0: review 1 findings fixed on their main paths; not ready. I: when git worktree add fails (a folder left from an earlier round with the same name, or an unreachable commit), the separate run lines go on and check the old round's commit or the PL's own folder (reproduced in a scratch repo, zsh). Minors: a team finish whose own approve call loses to a web approval leaves its record; the prompt's cleanup step is one line for many repos; the do-not-follow wording conflicts with Verify items and an ASSUMED line with a newline can close the fence; a fresh worktree has no dependencies; the folder uses the free-text repo name; an oversized record's set-aside name is coarse and untested.

evaluation.feedback: Implement attempt 3. I: name the worktree after the commit (../<safe repo>-story-<N>-<sha12>), chain add && (cd dir && { checks; }) so a failure stops, cleanup on its own line per repo, same in the prompt, with a test pinning the chain and the commit in the name. Minors: runFinish moves its record aside as superseded when approve answers STATE and the Hub now shows an approval; per-repo cleanup lines in the prompt; reword the data note to forbid only work beyond the check and flatten each item to one line; a note to install dependencies in the fresh folder; safe folder names ([\w-]); the oversized record's name keeps the full time and is tested.
